novel_features.name: Stale members
novel_features.description: Find members whose lastLogin is older than N days.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining lastLogin against a local snapshot the API does not filter on.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to find dormant accounts for cleanup or re-engagement campaigns, this is the single command to reach for. The dashboard and MCP cannot filter by lastLogin server-side.

novel_features.name: Plan coverage matrix
novel_features.description: Pivot active plan-connections across all members; flag members with zero active plans.
novel_features.rationale: Pivots planConnections[].planId across all members locally; Memberstack's UI shows this one member at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents auditing 'which members have access to which plans' should call this once instead of N member-get calls.

novel_features.name: Custom-fields flatten
novel_features.description: Pivot every member's customFields map into a flat table (CSV or JSON).
novel_features.rationale: Custom fields are nested per-member; flattening them for analysis requires local data.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents producing BI or marketing exports should not have to hand-write the pivot; one command produces the spreadsheet shape.

novel_features.name: Token decode (offline)
novel_features.description: Decode a Memberstack JWT locally without calling the API.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local parse; verify requires the secret, decode does not.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to inspect a JWT during frontend debugging, this is faster than verify and works without the secret key.

novel_features.name: Bulk delete by predicate
novel_features.description: Wipe members matching a SQL WHERE clause, with --dry-run preview.
novel_features.rationale: Combines local SQL query plus per-row delete with --dry-run preview.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents asked to clean up sandbox test accounts should call this once. Always preview first; explicit --apply required to commit.

novel_features.name: Watch new signups
novel_features.description: Poll the cursor and print new members as they arrive (live tail).
novel_features.rationale: Memberstack has no streaming API; cursor-polling is the only way.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to react to new signups (alerting, enrichment, Slack notify), pipe this through jq instead of building a webhook receiver.

novel_features.name: Audit / drift
novel_features.description: Diff the local snapshot against live to surface what changed since the last sync.
novel_features.rationale: Requires two snapshots; only possible because we persist locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents validating a deploy or investigating support tickets should call this to see what mutated.

novel_features.name: Plans roll-up (inferred)
novel_features.description: Build a plans index from planConnections observed across sync, with (planId, member-count, lastSeen).
novel_features.rationale: Memberstack does not expose plans via REST; inferring from connections is the only available signal.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to know which plan IDs are in use without opening the dashboard, this is the shortcut.

novel_features.name: Records find (shorthand)
novel_features.description: Build the Prisma findMany payload from --where, --order-by, --limit flags.
novel_features.rationale: The Prisma envelope is verbose; agents should not write it by hand.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents querying custom data tables get the same expressiveness without constructing JSON envelopes.

narrative.headline: The first CLI for Memberstack — every Admin API endpoint plus stale-member detection, plan coverage, JWT decode, bulk operations, and a local SQLite mirror no SDK or MCP has.
narrative.value_prop: Memberstack ships an SDK and an MCP server, but no command-line tool. memberstack-pp-cli covers every Admin REST endpoint with agent-native --json output, then adds a local SQLite mirror that powers stale-member detection, plan-coverage pivots, custom-fields flatten, drift audit, and one-shot snapshot export — things no dashboard, SDK, or MCP can do. Writable via the CLI: member emails, custom-field values, metaData, plan-connections, and custom data records. Dashboard-only: defining new custom field names, creating plans, and creating new data tables (the REST API does not expose these).
narrative.auth_narrative: Authenticate by exporting MEMBERSTACK_SECRET_KEY (sk_sb_* for sandbox / test mode, sk_* or sk_live_* for live mode). Keys come from Memberstack > Dev Tools. The CLI never reads the browser-side public key (pk_*) — that is for the DOM SDK only. Rate limit is 25 requests/sec; the sync command paces itself automatically.

quickstart.comment: Confirm auth, network, and store are wired up before doing anything else.
Mirror every member into the local SQLite store.
Set custom-field values on a member — preview with --dry-run, remove the flag to commit.
Find dormant members in one command — no equivalent in dashboard or MCP.
Pivot active plan-connections across every member; zero-plan members are flagged.

troubleshoots.fix: Check the key prefix — sk_sb_* for sandbox, sk_* or sk_live_* for live. Public keys (pk_*) are browser-only and will not work.
Memberstack caps at 25 req/sec. Pass --rate-limit 20 to back off, or wait ≈60 seconds and retry.
Plans live in the dashboard, not the REST API. Run plans list to see the plan IDs the CLI has observed in planConnections.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for memberstack-pp-cli whenever a Memberstack task is scriptable: bulk member operations, custom-fields exports for BI, sandbox cleanup, JWT inspection during frontend debugging, ad-hoc analytics on plan coverage or signup velocity, or backups and GDPR exports. Use it instead of writing a Node script when the workflow is one-shot or short. Keep the MCP server for long-running agent conversations that need natural-language access.

recipes.title: Find and clean up dormant test accounts
recipes.command: memberstack-pp-cli stale --days 60 --json --select id,auth.email | jq -r '.[].id' | xargs -I{} memberstack-pp-cli members delete {} --dry-run
recipes.explanation: Dry-run preview; remove --dry-run when you are ready to commit.

recipes.title: Export every member with custom fields flattened to CSV
recipes.explanation: One row per member; one column per custom field plus auth.email, planConnections, lastLogin.

recipes.title: Watch new signups
recipes.explanation: Cursor-polls the API; one JSON object per new member, pipeable to jq or any other notifier.

recipes.title: Find members with no active plan
recipes.explanation: Identifies free-tier members who should be re-engaged or pruned.

recipes.title: Query a custom data table without building a Prisma envelope
recipes.explanation: Shorthand flags compile to the Prisma findMany payload the API expects.
